description: Camden Property Trust, a Texas real estate investment trust formed on May 25, 1993, and its consolidated subsidiaries are primarily engaged in the ownership, management, development, reposition, redevelopment, acquisition and construction of multifamily apartment communities, which it refers to as communities, multifamily communities, properties or multifamily properties. It makes its annual, quarterly and current reports available free of charge through its website, and it views how it manages its human capital as critical to how it delivers on its strategy and creates sustained growth and value for its shareholders, seeking to differentiate itself by its culture and talent.
